harden.result:
PROBLEM RESTATED
The surviving S3 atom certifies, on one committed quintic, ||p(t)-c(t)|| >= R for all continuous t, where R = r_obs + r_body + d_safe + q_conformal(split-conformal, distribution-free, Mondrian class×density) + eps_track. Shipped impl (local_opt_hardalm.hpp:236-267) does this with a per-control-point FROZEN supporting halfspace g = R - a^T(P-c) <= 0. That halfspace (a) under-approximates the ball complement (conservative, fine) but (b) for a MOVER uses a different center per control-point time (t_pt(i,k)), so the convex-hull-over-time argument does NOT hold -> patched with dense K>=200 sampling (plan_minco.hpp:73), which is NOT sound (misses between samples). Track A replaces both with an EXACT continuous-time deficit whose float-sign is rigorous: computed b̄_k <= 0 => true b_k <= 0.

CORE IDEA — degree-10 quadratic deficit (deg5 -> deg10)
Per (segment i, sphere agent h): relative position r(t)=p(t)-c(t) is a vector quintic; S(t)=||r(t)||^2 is a degree-10 polynomial. Deficit D(t)=R^2 - S(t). Safety <=> D(t)<=0 forall t. In the degree-10 Bernstein basis on [0,T_i], D = sum_k b_k B_k^10, and D(t) <= max_k b_k (Bernstein convex-hull bound). So:
  CERTIFIED  <=>  max_k b_k <= 0,  with  b_k = R^2 - S_k  (S_k = deg-10 Bernstein coeff of ||r||^2).
This is exact continuous-time (no K-sampling), handles the mover by carrying c(t) as a polynomial (no per-CP-time halfspace), and tiles the horizon by segment with no per-step union bound (vs Lindemann/Dixit discrete CP-MPC). The conformal radius enters ONLY through R^2 -> clean split: geometry is deterministic+exact, the 1-eps coverage lives entirely in q_conformal.

ALGORITHM (per segment i, per sphere agent h)
1. Position Bernstein control points (exact-from-c seam). Authoritative state is power-basis c (eval_deriv uses it). Build P_i in the SAME exact map control_points() uses but as an interval/rational enclosure: P_i = C2B * diag(1,T,T^2,T^3,T^4,T^5) * cseg_i. cseg rows are doubles = exact dyadic; T^j by interval powers; C2B entries are integer/60 (1/60 NOT dyadic -> represent as [down(n/60),up(n/60)] interval, or exact rational n/60). Gives rigorous enclosure [P_lo,P_hi] of the TRUE Bernstein control points of the flown polynomial.
2. Obstacle center polynomial. CV predictor: c(t)=c0+v t (deg 1); CA: +0.5 a t^2 (deg 2). Build its Bernstein coeffs on [0,T_i] (exact: c0, c0+vT, ... via the same power->Bernstein).
3. Degree elevation c -> deg 5. Iterate b'_k = (k/(d+1)) b_{k-1} + (1-k/(d+1)) b_k for d=d_c..4. Ratios k/(d+1) are exact rationals (intervals in float path). Now both p and c are deg-5 Bernstein on the same knot vector.
4. Relative position. r_k = P_{i,k} - c_k, k=0..5 (6x3), interval subtraction.
5. Square each coordinate via Bernstein product (Chu-Vandermonde), m=n=5 -> deg 10:
     h_k = sum_{i=max(0,k-5)}^{min(5,k)} [ C(5,i)*C(5,k-i)/C(10,k) ] r_i r_{k-i}.
   Binomials are exact precomputed integers; only /C(10,k) is non-integer (one interval/rational division). Sum over x,y,z -> S_k (11 coeffs).
6. Deficit + decide. b_k = R2 - S_k. Float path: use b̄_k = R2_hi - S_lo,k (upper R^2, LOWER S enclosure). CERTIFIED iff max_k b̄_k <= 0. R2 from rounding UP each of r_obs,r_body,d_safe,q_conformal,eps_track then squaring up. Returns also margin = -max_k b̄_k (continuous-time slack, usable as the optimizer constraint instead of the K-sampled g).

WALLS (AABB) — cheaper exact path. For a polytope face with outward normal n (exact), the deficit is LINEAR in P: g(t) = (d_safe+eps) - n^T(p(t)-x_face) = sum_k [ (d_safe+eps) - n^T(P_{i,k}-x_face) ] B_k^5. No degree elevation / no product: the per-control-point values ARE the deg-5 Bernstein coeffs, so max over k of the (interval-rounded) per-CP deficit IS the exact continuous-time bound. The shipped halfspace path is already this up to rounding; only needs the interval wrapper to be sound.

TWO ARITHMETIC BACKENDS
(A) Onboard real-time: Interval{lo,hi} doubles. Two sound rounding styles -- (i) directed rounding via fesetround(FE_UPWARD/DOWNWARD) per op (rigorous, but mode switches stall the pipeline), or RECOMMENDED (ii) round-to-nearest + a-posteriori running-error bound: carry magnitude sum mu, final enclosure half-width gamma = (n_ops) * u * mu with u=2^-53 (TwoSum/TwoProduct-free, no mode switches). For this pipeline (~30 ops in series, magnitudes O(50 m^2)) gamma ~ 30*1.1e-16*50 ~ 1.7e-13 m^2 -- utterly negligible vs R^2~O(1), so the certificate loses essentially nothing.
(B) Audit / W7 gate ground-truth: exact rationals (GMP mpq) seeded from the doubles c,T. Every step (P from C2B*diag(T^j)*c, elevation, Chu-Vandermonde, deficit) is exactly representable -> b_k exact rationals, sign exact, ZERO gap. Numerators grow to a few hundred bits after squaring; fine for offline verification of the interval path and for the Boyle/W7 soundness exhibit.

INTEGRATION into minjerk_traj.hpp + new bernstein_cert.hpp
- minjerk_traj.hpp: add control_points_interval(int i) -> array<Interval,6x3>, mirroring control_points() (line 197) but C2B as integer/60 intervals and D=[1,T..T^5] as interval powers; reuses cseg=c.block. ~30 LOC. (Rational variant control_points_rational(i) for backend B.)
- new include/sando_cpp/bernstein_cert.hpp: Interval type + directed/running-error ops (~80), degree_elevate (~20), bernstein_square / product with cached binomial table (~40), deficit_and_margin(P_iv, c_poly, R2_iv) -> {b̄[11], margin, certified} (~60). ~200 LOC.
- local_opt_hardalm.hpp: alm_constraints (line 189+) currently emits per-CP g and the mover uses K-sampling. Replace the mover gate with deficit_and_margin per (i,h): one degree-10 deficit per segment-agent supersedes 6 per-CP halfspaces + the K>=200 sample loop. Keep halfspace as the smooth optimizer surrogate (gradient), use the exact deficit as the GATE/certificate. ~50 LOC + delete sampling gate.

COST / REAL-TIME (per segment, per sphere agent)
control_points_interval ~6*6*6*3 ~650 interval mul-add; elevate c ~ tens; subtract 18; 3 coords square (Chu-Vandermonde 11 coeffs, <=6 terms each + binom-ratio) ~300; assemble+max 11. Total ~1000 interval ops ~ few k flops. For M=8, H=10 -> 80 evals -> ~0.2-0.4 Mflop/replan -> single-digit microseconds on a Jetson-class core (running-error variant, no mode switches); sub-ms even with fesetround. Comfortably real-time at 10-50 Hz. Walls (linear) ~10x cheaper. Rational backend ~tens of us to ~1 ms per seg-agent (GMP) -> audit/offline only, NOT in the hot loop.

WHAT THIS BUYS vs SHIPPED
- Removes the unsound K>=200 mover-sampling gate (sampling can miss inter-sample collisions) -> exact continuous-time mover certificate.
- Float-sign soundness: b̄_k<=0 rigorously implies true b_k<=0 (interval) / exactly (rational).
- Tightens the conservative linear halfspace to the exact quadratic ball deficit (recovers margin the halfspace threw away).
- Preserves the clean conformal split: probabilistic content stays in q_conformal; geometry is now deterministically exact.
harden.soundness: SOUND with explicit scope. The float-sign soundness claim (b̄_k<=0 => true_b_k<=0) is RIGOROUS given: (i) the flown trajectory is the polynomial with power coeffs c -- true by construction (eval_deriv uses c); the P enclosure is built from c via interval/rational ops so it encloses the TRUE Bernstein coeffs (does NOT inherit any rounding from the float control_points()); (ii) R^2 is a rounded-UP enclosure of (r_obs+r_body+d_safe+q_conformal+eps_track)^2; (iii) interval ops use directed rounding OR a valid running-error bound (rational backend has zero gap). The Bernstein convex-hull bound D<=max_k b_k is a theorem. Segment-tiling => exact horizon union (no per-step union bound). This is the geometric/deterministic half. The PROBABILISTIC half is unchanged and inherited, not improved: P(collision or misclass)<=eps holds only under the existing split-conformal exchangeability within the Mondrian class×density cell -- valid in the NON-REACTIVE domain only. This atom does NOT repair the reactive/dynamic-pedestrian exchangeability break (that S-domain is dead). Novelty unchanged: distribution-free (vs Jasour moment/SOS) AND continuous-time exact (vs Lindemann/Dixit discrete CP-MPC) -- the hardening makes the 'continuous-time exact' claim literally true at float level, which the shipped K-sampled version did not deliver.
residual: Predictor mean must be representable as a per-segment polynomial of bounded degree d_c (CV=1/CA=2 exact). A learned non-polynomial mean must be polynomial-fit per segment with the fit residual folded into q_conformal, OR segments split at predictor knots; otherwise continuous-time exactness degrades to 'exact for the fitted center' (flag in writeup).

Conformal coverage assumption (exchangeability within Mondrian cell) is unchanged and is the load-bearing probabilistic premise; soundness here is purely the geometric inclusion. Does NOT fix reactive-pedestrian exchangeability break.

Obstacle model = ball (point+radius) for the degree-10 path; polytope walls use the linear deg-5 face deficit (also exact, cheaper). Non-spherical dynamic agents need a per-face or ellipsoidal extension (ellipsoid -> still a degree-10 quadratic form, straightforward; arbitrary mesh -> per-face union).
R^2 components (r_obs,r_body,d_safe,q_conformal,eps_track) must each be supplied as rigorous upper bounds; trivial (round up) but must be wired through pred_margin/eps_track plumbing.
Per-episode (multi-epoch) eps requires the separate Mondrian/exchangeability argument in the main spec; this atom certifies one committed trajectory per replan epoch, not the episode union.
No bigint/interval/degree-elevation/Bernstein-product code exists in repo (confirmed by grep); interval backend is self-contained but the rational audit backend adds a GMP dependency.

Running-error-bound interval variant needs a one-time numerical audit against the GMP rational ground truth + a 1e6-sample brute-force cross-check to validate gamma; until that test lands the directed-rounding (fesetround) variant is the conservative fallback.

Interval backend + tests (golden vs GMP rational + vs 1e6-sample brute force, ~150 LOC test): ~3-4 days. Optional GMP rational audit backend: +2 days + GMP dep. Wiring into local_opt_hardalm.hpp alm_constraints to replace the K>=200 mover gate while keeping the smooth halfspace as gradient surrogate: ~50 LOC, ~1 day. harden.result:
S3 Case B 重写: 学习型预测器 -> 多项式插值 -> 折回 Case A。

[记号] 单条已提交 ego quintic q(t); 连续时间 Bernstein 凸包 hull(q)=co{P_{i,k}} (repo 已有 control_points() @ include/sando_cpp/minjerk_traj.hpp:197, C2B_matrix() :18)。第 i 条被跟踪 track 真实未来轨迹 x_i(t), t in [0,H]。

[Case A, 已存活/sound] 预测对象本身是多项式 xhat_i(t); split-conformal 给半径 qhat_i 使 P(sup_t ||x_i - xhat_i|| <= qhat_i) >= 1-eps; 令 hull(q) 对 xhat_i 膨胀 (r_body+qhat_i+eps_track) 后, 精确连续时间 deficit>0 => per-traj / 跨标定边际 / 每回合 P(撞 track i) <= eps。

[Case B 病灶] 学习预测器 (NN/CV/CA 皆然) 输出离散 waypoint what_i={what_i(tau_m)}, 不是多项式。精确 Bernstein deficit 需要一个连续多项式对象; 若在离散 waypoint 上标定残差、却对某条插值曲线出证书, 则标定的非一致性分数不是进入 deficit 的那个对象的间隙 => 覆盖率失效 (软坍塌)。重写目标 = 消灭对象错配, 把 Case B 严格 reduce 成 Case A。

== 算法 (三步, 确定性算子优先于标定) ==
Step 1 固定插值算子 I_rho(.): 选一个部署期与标定期逐字节相同的确定性算子, 把 waypoint 序列 what_i 映成 degree-rho_i 多项式 xhat_i := I_{rho_i}[what_i] (least-squares / 节点插值, 在固定归一化 s=t/H 上, 固定基与节点)。经 C2B 转成 Bernstein 得 hull 可用控制点。I_rho 必须在标定之前冻结 (算子/degree/节点/归一化全部固定)。

Step 2 degree rho_i 的选择 (独立 fold, 非标定 fold): 三路划分 = 训练预测器 / 选 rho (model-selection fold) / conformal 标定。rho_i 在 selection fold 上以最小化插值残差 (或 AIC 式) 选定; 禁止在标定 fold 上调 rho, 否则按残差选 rho 把分位数 qhat 偏小 (对分位数过拟合) => 不 sound。rho 选定后并入 I_rho 被冻结。

Step 3 在 真值-vs-插值多项式 上标定 sup 残差 (关键纪律): 对标定集每条轨迹 j (由 Isaac 机载渲染 -> tracker 输出, 绝不用 SDD):
  e_j(t) = || x_j(t) - I_rho[what_j](t) ||
  S_j = max_m e_j(tau_m) + L_j*(dtau/2)   <- 离散 sup + Lipschitz 余量 (见下)
取 qhat = 第 ceil((1-eps)(n+1)) 顺序统计量 (split-conformal 经验分位数)。
此时 (xhat_i, qhat) 即 Case A 输入: hull(q) 对 xhat_i 膨胀 (r_body+qhat+eps_track), 跑精确连续时间 Bernstein deficit。Case B 已折回 Case A。

== Soundness 论证 (覆盖学习型预测器, 不限 CA) ==
令测试 track i 与标定集 {j} 在 I_rho 冻结后可交换。非一致性分数定义在与证书同一个对象上:
  S = sup_{t in [0,H]} || x(t) - I_rho[what](t) ||。
Split-conformal (Vovk; Lei et al. 2018) 给 P(S_test <= qhat) >= 1-eps, distribution-free。事件 {S_test <= qhat} 逐字面意味真实 track 全程落在以证书多项式 xhat=I_rho[what] 为心、半径 qhat 的管内 => 命中 Case A 前提。该事件上精确 Bernstein deficit>0 => 真轨迹与 ego hull 分离 => 不撞。故 P(撞 track i) <= P(S_test > qhat) <= eps。QED。
误分类同构: 把 conformal 分类集合的非一致性分数与上面位置分数并入同一整段 sup/max-over-horizon 时间整形分数 (避免 per-step union), 拆 eps=eps_cls+eps_pred=0.02+0.08。

[为何不限 CA] 推导只用到 (a) xhat 由一个冻结确定性算子产生 (NN/CV/CA/任意黑盒预测器 与 I_rho 复合后仍是冻结映射), (b) (x, what) 联合分布上的可交换性。预测器的模型误设只抬高 qhat, 永不破坏覆盖。故 soundness 不依赖恒加速 (CA) 或任何动力学假设, 显式覆盖学习型预测器。

== interpolant discipline 子条件 (标定对象 === 证书多项式对象) ==
设 D = 部署期算子, C = 标定期算子。Sound 的充要纪律:
(D1) C === D 逐字节 (同 rho、同基、同节点、同时间归一化、同 waypoint 来源)。
(D2) 标定残差 e_j 的被减项 = I_rho[what_j], 即标定测量的间隙对象 === 进入 deficit 的多项式 xhat。
(D3) deficit 计算的对象 = I_rho[what] (含 qhat 膨胀), 不得另起平滑/拟合。
任何 D1-D3 失配 (例: 在 raw waypoint 上标定却对 spline 出证 / degree 不同 / 测试期改 rho) 都使 S_j 不再上界证书对象的间隙, 覆盖保证作废。这正是 planner-vs-benchmark-split.md A2 软化走廊会触发的破坏: 改证书对象而不改标定对象。

== 标定端 sup 离散化 Lipschitz 余量 ==
deficit (ego 侧) 精确连续 (Bernstein), qhat 是常数; 唯一离散化在标定端 — 真实 track x_j 只在网格 {tau_m} 采样, 离散 sup 低估真 sup。设残差 e(t)=||x(t)-xhat(t)|| 在 t 上 L-Lipschitz, L 由 (真 track 速度上界 + 插值导数上界 ||xhat'||_inf, 后者由 Bernstein 一阶差分闭式上界) 给出: |e(t)-e(t')| <= L|t-t'|, 其中 L <= v_max_track + max_t ||I_rho[what]'(t)||。则
  sup_t e(t) <= max_m e(tau_m) + L*(dtau/2), dtau = 网格间距。
故标定分数必须用 S_j = max_m e_j(tau_m) + L_j*(dtau/2) (Step 3)。这是唯一需要余量的地方; ego 侧无离散化误差。

== 与既有/已死边界的区隔 ==
区别于 Jasour (moment/SOS, 需障碍矩) = distribution-free; 区别于 Lindemann/Dixit (离散步 CP-MPC) = 连续时间精确 deficit + sup-over-horizon 时间整形 (非 per-step union); 区别于 2511.10586 (反应行人) = 本原子显式限 non-reactive 域 (可交换性需要)。Case B 重写本身的新点: 把 conformal 标定对象强制 === 连续时间证书多项式对象 (interpolant discipline) + 标定端唯一离散化的 Lipschitz 闭合, 使 distribution-free 覆盖在学习预测器 (非 CA) 上无缝接到精确 Bernstein deficit。
harden.soundness: SOUND, 条件成立时严格 (split-conformal 覆盖 + 事件上精确 Bernstein deficit 的链式蕴含完整, QED 见 result)。覆盖学习型预测器, 不限 CA: 推导只依赖冻结确定性算子 + 可交换性, 与预测器内部模型/动力学无关; 预测器误设只抬 qhat 不破覆盖。但全链 sound 依赖 7 项尚未消解的假设/未实现件 (见 residual), 其中最硬的两条: (1) 可交换性把本原子锁死在 non-reactive 域 (反应行人破坏可交换性, 与 2511.10586 已占边界一致); (2) 精确连续时间 deficit 所需的 degree-elevation + Bernstein-product 代码 repo 内尚不存在 (当前 shipped 证书是 per-control-point halfspace 的保守内逼近, 非精确 deficit), 未实现前 soundness 仅为纸面定理。仍属 non-reactive 域、未实现。
residual: 可交换性 (exchangeability): 标定集与测试 track 同分布且可交换 — 反应行人/分布漂移破坏之, 本原子锁死 non-reactive 域 (与 2511.10586 边界一致)
Lipschitz 常数 L 必须是残差 e(t) 的真上界 (需 v_max_track 上界 + 插值导数闭式上界); L 低估则 sup 余量不 sound

精确连续时间 deficit 依赖 degree-elevation + Bernstein-product + interval-arith, repo 内全无 (确认: minjerk_traj.hpp 无 deficit/product/elevation 代码); shipped 证书是 per-control-point halfspace 保守逼近, 非精确 deficit — 未实现前定理仅纸面
per-track 边际 vs 多 track 联合: eps 默认 per-track, 多 track 需 union/Bonferroni 或 Mondrian (3类x3密度=9格) 分层修正
管为各向同性球 (单标量 sup 分数); 各向异性需向量/椭球 conformal, 本原子未覆盖
三路 fold 划分纪律: rho 只能在 selection fold 选、I_rho 标定前冻结; 测试期改 rho 或在标定 fold 调 rho 即破覆盖
标定数据须来自 Isaac 机载渲染 -> tracker 输出 (绝不用 SDD 标定证书); 真 track 仅采样, 故标定端 sup 必带 Lipschitz 余量
harden.build_cost: 中等, 主成本在尚缺的精确 deficit 原语。(1) 插值算子 I_rho: 对 NN waypoint 拟合 degree-rho 多项式 (小型最小二乘, 复用 C2B_matrix) ~0.5 天。(2) degree-elevation + Bernstein-product 求 ego-minus-xhat 相对轨迹的精确连续时间 deficit (repo 现无, 需新写; 当前只有 per-control-point halfspace 保守证书) ~2-3 天, 是关键路径。(3) 三路 fold + Lipschitz 余量标定 harness (含 ||xhat'||_inf 的 Bernstein 一阶差分闭式上界 + max_m e + L*dtau/2 + 经验分位数) ~1 天, 依赖 Isaac 渲染->tracker 标定数据就绪。(4) capi 共享库需手动重编 (capi/sando_capi.cpp, 不在 CMake 图内)。合计约 4-5 工程日 (不含标定数据采集); 前置门槛 = W4 预测器 q95<=0.6-0.7m。

harden.result:
把 S3 存活原子(单条已提交 quintic 上 split-conformal tube 半径折进精确连续时间 Bernstein-deficit)从『边际覆盖』升级到『部署可用语义』。四件套:

== 1. Training-conditional 膨胀 (marginal -> PAC, 运行时零成本) ==
原 spec 用边际分位 q_hat = s_(k0), k0 = ceil((n+1)(1-alpha)),只保证 标定×测试 联合抽样下的平均覆盖。部署时标定集已固定,真实条件覆盖 C(q_hat)=P(s_{n+1} <= q_hat | cal) 是随机量;连续无 tie 时 C(s_(k)) ~ Beta(k, n+1-k)。
- Vovk Beta-tail (推荐): 选 k_beta = min{ k : BetaInv(delta; k, n+1-k) >= 1-alpha }。正态近似 k_beta ~ (n+1)(1-alpha) + z_delta*sqrt(n*alpha*(1-alpha))。给出 (1-alpha, 1-delta) PAC: w.p.>=1-delta over cal, 条件覆盖>=1-alpha。半径 r(t)=s_(k_beta)*rho(t)。
- DKW (n,delta) 备选 (更松、纯 distribution-free): Massart 单边 P(sup(F-F_hat)>gamma)<=exp(-2n*gamma^2), gamma_n=sqrt(ln(1/delta)/(2n)),取经验分位水平 1-alpha+gamma_n, index k=ceil((n+1)(1-alpha+gamma_n))。
- 实现关键: 半径仍是每 Mondrian 格一个预算好的标量 -> 走 spec 第5节已通的 q_conformal 标量钩子 (OptParams->ALM) + [0,tau_trust] 窗内 sup 标量化『零手术』路径。training-conditional 只改离线选哪个 order statistic,运行时零成本、零 ABI 改动、不触发 golden 19/19 重基线。

== 2. per-round vs per-flight 诚实记账 (~80 commit/架次不复利) ==
- 原子保证(certificate): per-(track i, round r): P(在第 r 回合 committed 执行窗 [0,tau_commit] 内撞 i) <= eps_pred(+eps_cls), conditional 在单一 cal 事件(prob 1-delta)。
- 不复利的真相要诚实: flight 级『整段不撞』= union_r 事件, Boole 给 sum-of-eps 必然复利, 不能宣称。两个真正不复利的对象: (a) per-round/per-track 保证本身(每回合独立成立); (b) 期望违例率 E[#collisions/flight]=sum_{r,i} P <= (sum_r H_r)*eps —— 线性期望, 不需独立、不需 union、不 vacuous, 这是诚实的 flight 级 KPI。
- 窗不复利缩放: 撞 i 的事件按 committed 窗 [0,tau_commit] 定义, 相邻窗时间不相交且铺满 track 在感知/horizon 内的寿命 L_i。flight 级 per-track 上界 = L_i*eps, 而 L_i=(track 在程时长)/tau_commit ~ 3-8 窗(非全 80 回合)—— track 只在进范围时相关。要硬上界就报 L_i*eps(或按 eps/L_max 收紧 per-round alpha), 否则报期望率。匹配 spec『per-mission 不承诺』。
- 复用同一 cal 集的诚实标注: 80 回合共用一个 q_hat_beta -> per-round 分数非互相独立; 但 (i) 每回合边际/PAC 保证仍成立(逐回合 test 与 cal 可交换), (ii) 期望/Boole 都不需独立。复用唯一破坏的是『(1-eps)^N 连乘』式声明 —— 而我们从不做。

== 3. H agent 预算分配与有限分位可行性 ==
- 分配: per-round P(存在可见 i 撞)<=eps_pred, Boole 拆 eps_pred=sum alpha_i。对 H_max(格的设计密度上限)等分 alpha=eps_pred/H_max; 任意实跑 H<=H_max 都有 sum alpha = H*alpha <= eps_pred, 单个预编半径全格通用、保守安全。
- delta 只付一次/格(诚实增效): 全格共用一个 cal 集 + 一个半径 q_hat_beta -> 条件覆盖是单个数 C(q_hat_beta), 『w.p.1-delta 对所有 H 个 agent 同时成立』是单一 cal 事件, delta 不随 H 拆。前提: 所有 H 个 agent 用同一 q_hat_beta 同一 rho (构造上为真)。
- 有限分位可行性: 取第 k 阶统计量要 k<=n 才有限(否则 q=+inf, 走廊封死)。
  * 边际下界: k0=ceil((n+1)(1-alpha))<=n 等价 n >= 1/alpha - 1 = H_max/eps_pred - 1 (与 task 提示一致)。验算: H=10,eps_pred=0.08 -> n>=124, 与 spec『每格最少124条』精确吻合。
  * training-conditional Beta-tail 把下界放大 ~常数倍: n >= ((z_delta+sqrt(z_delta^2+4))/2)^2 * H_max/eps_pred。delta=0.05 时系数 ~4.49。实算: H=10 -> n>=561; H=20 -> 1121; H=30 -> 1682。
  * DKW 形式昂贵得多 (n ~ (H/eps)^2*ln(1/delta)/2): H=10 -> 23405, H=30 -> 210638 —— 密集档不可行, 故推荐 Beta-tail。
- 诚实增效结论: spec 计划的『舒服 1,250 条/格』已超过 training-conditional Beta-tail 在 H<=10 的 561 条下界 —— 即从 marginal 硬化到 PAC 在现有数据预算下基本免费。

== 4. 密集 H>10 证书有效域 ==
有效域 D_valid 由三个 binding 约束的 min 决定, H_max(cell)=min(H_feas, H_corridor, H_bin):
1. 数据可行性 H_feas: 给定每格 n, Beta-tail 需 n >= 4.49*H/eps_pred (delta=0.05)。n=1250/格 -> H_feas ~ 22; n=561 -> H_feas ~ 10。
2. 走廊封死 H_corridor: 半径 r=s_(k_beta)*rho(t_h) 必须 < (走廊半宽 - 机体半径)。H 增 -> alpha 降 -> k_beta/n -> 1 -> q_hat_beta 趋向标定残差极大值。即使数据够, 高阶分位(如 alpha=eps_pred/30=0.0027 的 99.7% 分位)可达 q95 的 2-3 倍 (1.8-2.7m) 先封死走廊 —— 实务中常是真正 binding 的约束。
3. 交换性域 H_bin: H>10 是不同 Mondrian 密度档, 必须在该档内标定(协变量偏移), 不能用稀疏档半径外推到密集部署。
- 越界降级(保 soundness): 超过 H_max(cell), 从 per-agent 统计 tube(分支1)退到确定性『密集簇当最坏占据/遮挡阴影』(分支2): 把密集簇当可达占据区, 确定性半径 r_occ + v_max*t, 预算 0。soundness 不破, 代价是保守。H_max(cell) 作为每格发布参数。

hunt.idea:
Turn the surviving S3 verifier (distribution-free split-conformal radius folded into the EXACT continuous-time Bernstein convex-hull deficit) from a pass/fail oracle into a principled, sampling-free escape by exploiting the deficit's analytic structure.

Per round, per tracked agent i, on the already-committed quintic c(t), t in [0,T]:
1. Deficit (S3, already the atom): relative curve r_i(t)=c(t)-p_i(t) is a polynomial; ||r_i(t)||^2 in Bernstein via degree-elevation + Bernstein-product (NOT in repo yet). Certified clearance lower bound = convex hull of control points; deficit g_i(t)=LB_clear(t)-rho_i(t)-r_b, with rho_i(t) the conformal tube at lead-time t.
2. Analytic EVENT extraction (new, no K>=200 sampling): t*_i = first root of g_i = exact first-violation-time (Bernstein subdivision / companion-matrix roots); t_ca,i = argmin g_i = root of polynomial g_i'(t) = closest-approach-time. If min_i,t g_i>=0 -> commit.
3. Certified timing-only escape (new): introduce monotone clock warp t->t/alpha (alpha in [alpha_min,alpha_max] from dyn limits). G(alpha)=min_i min_t [LB_clear_warp(t;alpha)-rho_i(t)-r_b] is piecewise-analytic; dG/dalpha at the active (i,t_ca) is CLOSED-FORM via chain rule through control_points() and dM_dT_times_c()/solve_adjoint() already in minjerk_traj.hpp. Newton on dG/dalpha for smallest |alpha-1| with G>=0.
4. Feasibility CERTIFICATE (honest core): if alpha* exists in admissible band with G(alpha*)>=0 -> APPLY warp; certificate restored, NO replan, NO sampling, per-episode P(hit i)<=eps preserved (rho untouched, only drone clock warped). Else emit a proof that G(alpha)<0 over the whole admissible band ("timing-only infeasible") and hand to full replan / RTA backup. Retiming never changes z, so the robot stays inside the already-certified geometric corridor -> structurally avoids the vertical-climb-into-unmodeled-canopy pathology flagged in the benchmark critique.

Net new micro-atom: the certificate's exact first-violation-time/closest-approach-time both TRIGGERS and PARAMETERIZES a closed-form minimal time-warp, plus a closed-form go/no-go deciding whether timing alone restores a distribution-free per-track per-episode guarantee on a committed polynomial.
hunt.collision_check:
Closest priors found via web:
- CP-SIPP / arXiv 2511.18170 "Time-aware Motion Planning ... with Conformal Prediction" (Nov 2025): confidence-indexed safe intervals but DISCRETE graph states + wait/move + reactive replan. Diff: mine = continuous-time EXACT polynomial roots of a conformal-Bernstein deficit on a committed quintic, escape = closed-form clock-warp not graph search/wait.
- IRA / arXiv 2510.16376 "Conformal Prediction in the Loop" (feedback-CP + iterative risk allocation): re-solves a risk-allocated optimization every step. Diff: mine does NOT re-solve; it warps committed-trajectory time using the certificate's own adjoint gradient.
- Classic ST-graph / path-velocity decomposition speed planning: "retime to dodge a dynamic obstacle" is OLD and well established; no conformal guarantee, no analytic violation-time trigger, no closed-form feasibility certificate.
- Continuous-time spline safety (arXiv 2111.00951, 2603.24133): exact-in-time safety but STATIC obstacles, full time-optimal re-solve, no conformal/probabilistic layer, no event trigger.
- Event-triggered control literature: triggers controller updates, unrelated to using a risk certificate root to retime.
None combine: analytic first-violation-time of a distribution-free conformal continuous-time deficit + closed-form warp-feasibility on a committed polynomial without sampling/replanning. The delta is real but the retiming primitive itself is heavily anticipated.
hunt.soundness_sketch: Sound where it succeeds, one-sided complete. (1) The warp leaves conformal calibration untouched: rho_i is indexed by lead-time and evaluated at the real future time of the agent; only the drone's clock is reparameterized, so the split-conformal marginal validity (per track, per episode) carries through unchanged. (2) Bernstein convex-hull bound is an EXACT lower bound, so G(alpha)>=0 => g_i(t)>=0 for all t => certified P(hit i)<=eps_cls+eps_pred. (3) Success is provably safe; the feasibility test G(alpha)<0 over the band is itself exact (piecewise-analytic in alpha), giving an honest go/no-go. Incompleteness (honest weakness): retiming cannot create clearance for head-on / path-blocking geometry where temporal shift leaves relative geometry conflicting -> that case is detected in closed form and handed to fallback, NOT silently failed. Implementation gap: needs Bernstein degree-elevation + product + root extraction, which the repo does NOT have (confirmed: minjerk_traj.hpp has C2B/control_points/solve_adjoint/dM_dT but no deficit/interval/product code); adjoint + dM_dT primitives for the gradient already exist.
hunt.thesis_alignment: Feeds the certified safety layer main line: this is an RTA-style minimal-correction module ("最小修正" branch in plan §) that strictly respects the hard conformal certificate and is planner-agnostic (any committed trajectory has a clock; does not require the side-paper MINCO). Does NOT violate the 9/15 ironclad rules: touches no side-paper planner internals, leaves the FN three-branch / learned predictor / tracker-output calibration untouched. Positive bonus vs the benchmark critique: because the warp never changes z it keeps the robot on an already-certified geometric corridor, directly mitigating the "vertical-climb recovery escapes into unmodeled canopy / single-layer occupancy" structural pathology. Caveat: it is a cheap first-resort escape, not a full reactive solver, so it complements (not replaces) replan + vertical backup.

hunt.idea: 在【单条外部已提交 quintic p_ego(t)】上,对每个 track i 构造相对 deficit 多项式 d_i(t)=‖p_ego(t)-p̂_i(t)‖² −(R_safe+r_cp)²,其中 p̂_i 为 agent 标称预测(多项式/CV),r_cp 为 distribution-free split-conformal tube 半径(可时变项,折进常数/多项式)。关键:d_i(t) 是 t 的多项式 → 用 Bernstein degree-elevation + 凸包/Sturm/Bernstein-sign 根隔离,精确求出 {t∈[0,T]: d_i(t)<0} 的全部不相交风险区间 I_i=∪[τ_in^k,τ_out^k](首次进入时刻 = min real root)。伪代码:(1) 把 p_ego、p̂_i 各自的 Bernstein 控制点做积/差得 d_i 的 Bernstein 系数;(2) 凸包检验若全正→I_i=∅→S3 证书 P(撞 track i)≤ε 成立(替换仓库现役 K≥200 密采样 mover 门——后者会漏掉两采样点间薄穿透,是 unsound 的);(3) 若有负→精确根隔离得 I_i;(4) 跨 track 把 {τ_in^i} 排序 → 连续时间“谁先进 tube”的精确时空优先级,据此做抢/让排序与最小时序修正(沿原几何路径 retime,不改形,保住硬 SFC)。本质是想把 S3 窄核从 binary 证书扩成 first-entry-time-set + 优先级判决。
hunt.collision_check: 实搜命中三处强先验,把“first-entry-time set→时空优先级/抢让”这层吃干净:(1) Continuous-time SIPP（Phillips-Likhachev ICRA11）+ PSIPP-CTC（OMRON, 连续时间 2D roadmap 的 Prioritized Safe Interval Path Planning）+ continuous-time CBS —— 已经在连续时间里把动障转成每点/边的交替 safe/unsafe 时间区间并做带优先级的序贯避让，这正是我“风险区间+优先级”的核心；(2) CP-SIPP（Conformal Prediction SIPP，confidence-indexed safe intervals + adaptive quantile，finite-sample distribution-free，且已有无人机 B-spline 4D 时空走廊版，>95% 成功率 <300ms）—— 把 conformal 不确定性折进连续时间 safe-interval 这件事已被占；(3) CCD Bernstein Sign Classification（gamma.cs.unc.edu，Min Tang 等）—— 用 Bernstein 根隔离/中点细分求“精确 first time of contact”是图形/机器人 CCD 的老套路。另：Jasour 2106.05489 连续时间 risk-contour（moment/SOS）、2509.07607 把碰撞测为时间高阶单变量多项式求根（合点分析）。我这条 = 把这些已存在的零件（CP×连续时间 safe interval×Bernstein 根）拼成同一目标，区别仅剩“planner-agnostic、对外部已提交 quintic 做 runtime 证书、用精确 deficit 根而非 SIPP 的保守 roadmap 几何”——而这恰好就是已存活的 S3 窄核本身，优先级/抢让扩展没有买到新地。
hunt.soundness_sketch: 机制本体在静态/非反应域是 sound 的：Bernstein 凸包/根隔离对 deficit 多项式给出保守正确的“无负根”判定（比 K≥200 密采样 strictly sound——后者漏薄穿透），conformal 边际覆盖在 S3 已论证。但优先级/抢让扩展有两处会断：(a) 一旦“先进 tube 者”的判决进入闭环改 ego 行为，agent 反应使预测残差与 ego 动作耦合 → split-conformal 的可交换性破裂（与已判死的 2511.10586 同坑）；(b) 跨 track 用 first-entry 排序做联合判决需对 N 条 track 联合覆盖，若不付 Bonferroni/Mondrian 代价，per-round 联合证书不成立。即：可 sound 的部分恰是已有 S3，新增优先级层把 sound 性推向反应域风险。
hunt.thesis_alignment: 表面喂主线认证安全层（RTA 监视器 + 最小修正），且“精确 deficit 根替换 unsound 密采样门”是对仓库现役 mover 门（K≥200 密采样，见 minjerk_traj.hpp 周边、无 deficit/区间算术代码）的真实 soundness 修补、值得做工程化。但作为“新原子”不达标：first-entry-set+优先级扩展撞 CP-SIPP/PSIPP-CTC/CBS，且其反应化倾向逼近已判死的反应行人 per-episode 域，触碰 9/15 铁律边缘（侧重抢让=向 side-paper 规划行为漂移）。结论:不开新线，把精确根隔离当 S3 的 sound 实现细节落地即可，优先级判决不要立项。

hunt.idea:
机制名:Risk-Wealth Monitor —— 把"每回合 per-track 证书"做成一条 conformal test-(super)martingale(财富过程),用 Ville 不等式拿到【任务级、anytime-valid、可在数据依赖停时下成立】的撞击界,并用剩余财富(预算)驱动全局重路由/恢复。这是一个【时间/任务维度的全局机制 + unstuck 触发器】,不是几何 unstuck。

伪代码:
离线标定(Isaac tracker 输出,Mondrian 格 m=类×密度):每条标定 track 取整段 sup-over-horizon 的"净空-tube"分数 s_j,存 per-cell 经验分布。
在线第 k 回合,对每条 track i(格 m):
  deficit_i(k) = min_t [ 精确连续时间 Bernstein 凸包净空_i(t) - r_tube_i(t) ]   // 复用 S3 存活原子(含遮挡阴影 r_occ+v_max·t 作为额外减项、body-clearance 作硬门)
  E_{k,i} = calib_m(deficit_i(k))    // 构造 conformal e-value:零假设"tube 覆盖 track i"下 E[E_{k,i}|过去]≤1(betting/rank 函数)
  W_k = W_{k-1} · Π_i E_{k,i},  W_0=1
判定:只要 W_k < 1/ε 即"任务仍安全"。Ville: P(sup_k W_k ≥ 1/ε) ≤ ε —— 对 k 不做 union、对任意数据依赖停时(monitor 每回合 peek/任意时刻触发)都成立。
RTA 触发:任一 deficit_i<0 或 投影财富越过 ruin 阈 τ=c/ε → 触发。
全局/unstuck 耦合:剩余预算 B_k=log(1/ε)-log W_k;全局图边代价 = 该走廊的期望对数 e-value 消耗 E[log E](密集/遮挡走廊消耗快);当 B_k<B_min,前向路线"买不起"→ 触发全局重路由到最低消耗(稀疏/已观测)走廊,或执行认证 loiter/垂直 backup,在低消耗(高覆盖余量)区域回补预算。"卡住"用统计定义(预算将耗尽),非几何定义。
hunt.collision_check: 最接近先验:(1) Conformal Policy Control(arXiv 2603.02196)—— 已读其正文确认:用 conformal risk control 选单一策略,【不用 e-process/test martingale/Ville,不处理数据依赖停时、无 union-free 序列组合、无预算-路由耦合】。(2) "E-Values Expand the Scope of CP"(2503.13050)+ game-theoretic statistics/安全 anytime-valid(2210.01948)—— 提供 e-value/Ville 数学底座,但是纯统计,非机器人 RTA/避撞。(3) conformal test martingale 已用于 change-point/感知故障 runtime monitor(2504.13478)—— 是"检测分布漂移",不是"作避撞 RTA 干预触发器并给任务级撞击界"。(4) SMPC online risk allocation(2604.04602)/ Ono 风险分配 —— horizon 内静态分配,非跨任务 anytime-valid、非 e-process、不耦合 unstuck。(5) 2511.10586(对抗鲁棒 CP,交互域可交换性破)—— 占住"动态/反应行人 per-episode",我这条不碰反应保证,只做停时有效性+任务级组合。区别点:把 per-track 精确连续时间 Bernstein deficit 当 e-value 统计量喂进 conformal 财富过程 → 解决【shipped CP-safety/RTA 的隐藏 soundness bug:runtime monitor 连续 peek/数据依赖触发时,split-CP 的 P(miscover)≤ε 只在预先固定测试点成立,被 optional-stopping 充胀】,且把 N 回合从 union-bound ε·N 降成常数 anytime-valid ε,再用财富当全局预算驱动 unstuck。web 实搜未见此复合体。
hunt.soundness_sketch: 骨干 sound:Ville 不等式作用在非负 conformal test-supermartingale 上,给"任务内任意一回合提交了未覆盖/不安全动作"的概率 ≤ ε,对任意数据依赖停时与连续监视都成立,且无需对回合数 union(把 ε·N 退化界换成常数界)——这是相对现有固定测试点 CP-MPC/RTA 的真实修复。per-round e-value 继承 S3 的 distribution-free per-track 覆盖;Mondrian per-cell 标定保住类×密度分层内有效性。重路由是上层控制策略,不影响统计保证(保证是关于 monitor 声明/提交轨迹的)。诚实弱点(故 partial):e-value 的鞅性 E[E|过去]≤1 在闭环交互(策略改变行人行为→2511.10586 的可交换性破)下不自动成立;Ville 解决"数据依赖停时",但"闭环条件有效性"需对抗鲁棒 e-value/协议级鞅,这是必须显式处理的洞。仓库侧:q_conformal/eps_track/连续时间 spheres 证书已在(local_opt_hardalm.hpp、minco_cost_grad.hpp、types.hpp),但无 martingale/wealth/episode 组合代码 → e-process 层未实现(白区但可在现有原语上落地)。
hunt.thesis_alignment: 强对齐主线、不违铁律。直接硬化主论文的两个核心件:① RTA 监视器(原本就是主线"独立监视器节点")—— 给它 anytime-valid 的停时有效触发保证;② per-round→任务级证书组合 —— 把 P(撞 track i)≤ε 从单回合升成任务级无 union 界。统计量 = 存活 S3 原子(精确连续时间 Bernstein deficit + conformal tube),标定在 Isaac tracker 输出、per Mondrian 格,完全符合 spec。不砍 FN 三分支:遮挡阴影 r_occ+v_max·t 作 deficit 减项、body-clearance 作硬门、预测器仍是成败手(q95 gate 不变)。不碰 side paper(9/15 铁律 OK)。摘要可写"任务级 anytime-valid"而非 per-step,符合防雷句式。unstuck/全局部分(预算-ruin 触发重路由)给出全局机制,但注意:它把恢复变成"预算驱动的认证决策"而非无认证垂直逃逸——真正修 eval台 结构 bug(垂直爬升逃进未建模树冠)仍需另行把 occupancy 做成 3D + 垂直认证分支,本机制不单独解决该实验台缺口。

synthesis.hardened_survivor:
存活原子仍只有一个:S3 窄核(distribution-free split-conformal tube 半径折进【单条已提交 quintic 的精确连续时间 Bernstein 凸包 deficit】,给 per-traj / 跨标定边际 / 每回合 P(撞或误分 track i)≤ε,non-reactive 域)。Track A 的 4 篇硬化(interval/GMP 双后端 soundness、training-conditional Beta-tail PAC 膨胀、per-round vs per-flight 诚实记账、H-agent 预算+有效域降级、Case B 学习预测器→插值算子→折回 Case A)数学全 sound、且都把概率内容干净地隔在 q_conformal 里——但它们全部架在一个【仓库内不存在】的原语之上。已核实:repo 无 degree-elevation / Bernstein-product / deficit / interval / mpq 任何代码;shipped 球证书是 per-control-point 支撑半空间(local_opt_hardalm.hpp:237-262),mover 用 per-CP-时刻中心 predict(t_pt(i,k)) → 凸包-over-time 论证本就不成立,只能靠 hard_clearance_trusted 密采样补(plan_minco.hpp:482,K=200,且只覆盖 [0,tau_trust=0.75],代码注释自承"连续时间证书其实只 hold 到 tau_trust")。即 shipped mover 门是双重 unsound(采样间漏穿 + 只 0.75s 截断,靠 receding-horizon 兜)。

距 demonstrated 还差(按硬度):(1) 核心原语未写=长杆:bernstein_cert.hpp(interval/running-error 或 fesetround + degree_elevate + Chu-Vandermonde 平方 + deg-10 凸包 min/max-coeff + margin)+ control_points_interval() 接缝,在它落地前 Track A 全是纸面 sound、不可端到端验证;(2) 把双重 unsound 的 mover 门换成精确 deficit 当 GATE、保留平滑半空间当梯度 surrogate——这才是真正的 soundness 修补;(3) 数值审计:interval 路径 vs GMP 有理 ground-truth + 1e6 暴力采样交叉验 running-error γ,未过前以 fesetround 为保守 fallback;(4) 概率半身未改且继承:可交换性把它永久锁死在 non-reactive 域(反应行人=2511.10586 已占=死),这是 SCOPE 不是 TODO;(5) 标定数据须 Isaac 机载渲染→tracker 输出(绝不用 SDD),前置 W4 预测器 q95≤0.6-0.7m,且密集档(H>10)Mondrian 格需真 Isaac 人群数据,稀疏档半径不能外推;(6) 评测台结构性跳不到它(见 doc_fix):静障当软 occupancy + 单层 z,硬证书路径与 FN 遮挡/body-clearance 分支根本不被触发,即使原语写好也没台子出 headline 图。残余:障碍模型=球(deg-10)+ AABB 墙(线性 deg-5),非球动障需椭球/逐面扩展;机体仍当点/球(A1 不在证书内,要进证书须做进 deficit 的椭球障碍模型,仍是 deg-10)。
new_algo_survivors: S7-CRET(Certified Retiming Escape Trigger):novelty=partial、sound-where-it-succeeds、单边完备。用 S3 deficit 的解析结构(首违时刻 t* = deficit 首根、最近接近时刻 = deficit' 的根)既触发又参数化一个闭式最小时钟 warp t->t/alpha,外加闭式 go/no-go 可行性证书;warp 只改无人机时钟、不动 z 与几何 → 留在已认证走廊内 → 直接消解评测台『垂直爬升逃进未建模树冠』病灶;只 reparameterize 无人机时钟故 split-conformal 边际覆盖原样穿过。诚实弱点:retiming 修不了正面/挡路几何(闭式检出后交 replan/垂直 backup,非静默失败);novelty 最窄(path-velocity/ST-graph 速度规划是老货,CP-SIPP 占了 confidence-indexed safe interval),delta 仅『distribution-free 连续时间 conformal-Bernstein deficit 的解析首违时刻 + 委托轨迹上无采样无 replan 的闭式 warp 可行性证书』未被先验占。强对齐主线 RTA 最小修正、planner-agnostic、不碰 side-paper、不砍 FN 分支。

W7-B-anytime-valid-riskwealth-monitor:novelty=partial、骨干 sound(non-reactive 域,同 S3 scope)。把每回合 per-track 证书做成 conformal test-(super)martingale 财富过程,e-value 就是 S3 deficit 经 per-cell 标定的 betting 函数,W_k=∏E;Ville 给 P(sup_k W_k≥1/ε)≤ε,对回合数不做 union、对任意数据依赖停时/连续 peek 都成立 → 修了一个真实隐藏 bug:split-CP 的 P(miscover)≤ε 只在预固定测试点成立,runtime monitor 每回合 peek/事件触发被 optional-stopping 充胀。同时把 Track A 自承『per-round 不复利成 mission 级、只能报期望率』的缺口升成 mission-级 anytime-valid 高概率界,并用剩余财富(预算)驱动全局重路由/认证 loiter。诚实弱点:E[E|past]≤1 在闭环交互(反应行人)下不自动成立,需对抗鲁棒 e-value 或显式限 open-loop-monitor 域(与 S3 同 scope);martingale/wealth/episode 组合代码 repo 内全无。
synthesis.best_new: 最值得推 = W7-B-anytime-valid-riskwealth-monitor(其次 S7-CRET 作互补的认证 escape)。理由,诚实:它是本波唯一产出【新 sound 定理】而非工程便利的候选——mission-级、optional-stopping-valid 的撞击界。三个胜点:(1) 它恰好补上 Track A 亲口承认补不上的洞:per-round 证书 Boole 必复利、只能诚实报期望违例率 E[#col]≤(ΣH)ε;Ville 财富过程把它换成『任务内任一回合提交未覆盖/不安全动作的概率 ≤ε』的真高概率界、且 N 回合不退化成 εN。(2) 它修一个 shipped CP-safety/RTA monitor 的真实 soundness bug(连续 peek 被 optional stopping 充胀),不是锦上添花。(3) 它本体就是『独立监视器节点』,是主线 RTA 的教科书形态,零 side-paper 风险、不碰 planner、不砍 FN 三分支,摘要可写『任务级 anytime-valid』正中防雷句式。但必须诚实标注两条:它是 partial novelty(e-process+Ville 数学底座是现成的、conformal test martingale 已用于 OOD/change-point 监测;未被占的只是『S3 连续时间 deficit 当 e-value 统计量 + mission-级避撞界 + 财富预算驱动 recovery』这一复合);且它的 genuinely-new delta 与 S3 是同一条轴(连续时间 conformal-Bernstein deficit),不是新轴。S7-CRET 给的是 ACTION(z-保持 escape,直杀树冠病灶、能出可见行为),但 novelty 最薄、价值偏工程,作第二顺位 build。两者都被同一未实现的 deficit 原语 gate 住。
synthesis.honest_verdict:
不粉饰:本波没开出新轴,但避免了『全坍』。逐项:Track B 4 个候选里,2 个过预检(S7-CRET、riskwealth-monitor,均 partial+骨干 sound),2 个死——TrackB-W7-conformal-Bernstein-inloop-hard(in-loop 反应性破可交换性=重踩死域 + in-loop trajopt 喂 side-paper、违 9/15,双杀;唯一可留=静障感知误差并入同一 deficit,但落点必须是 RTA 门不是 in-loop);W7-B-exactroot-entryset-priority(collides:first-entry-set+优先级被 CP-SIPP/PSIPP-CTC/连续时间 CBS/Bernstein-sign CCD 全占,可留的『精确根隔离』只是 S3 的 sound 实现细节、不是新原子)。

合起来的 genuinely-new+sound 账(诚实计法):按【独立新轴】算=仍是 1(连续时间 distribution-free conformal-Bernstein deficit),其余全挂在它下面。按【可发表的 new+sound 结果/原子】算=3:① S3 核(per-traj 连续时间精确证书,non-reactive 域);② anytime-valid 财富 monitor(mission-级新定理,同轴,RTA 层);③ S7-CRET(z-保持 retiming escape,同轴最窄,RTA 层,单边完备)。但三件全 paper-only、全 non-reactive 域、全被同一未实现 deficit 原语 gate 住,②③ 还各带一个真实未消解的洞(②闭环条件有效性、③正面几何不可修)。一句话总结:W7 把那唯一一条存活线挖深成『1 核 + 2 个 RTA 层同轴扩展(其一是新定理)』、没把它做宽;离 demonstrated 的关键路径仍是写出那 250 行原语 + 换掉双重 unsound 的 mover 门 + 搭一个能触发主线贡献的 non-reactive 评测台。
